money.no-tables: Prices, costs and payment rates exist only for fields in Iowa and Poland.
money.no-economics: No sourced yield, price or direct costs for {crop}, so income is not estimated.
money.condition.us-340: Only if your application is selected: EQIP is competitive. NRCS Iowa's FY2026 rate for a single-species cover crop, paid per acre in each year with a cover crop, for up to 5 years on the same land. No full-width tillage after the cover crop until the next cash crop. Spread over the years of this rotation.
money.condition.us-328-basic: Only if your application is selected: EQIP is competitive. NRCS Iowa's FY2026 rate for planning a rotation of at least two different crop types (the current maize–soybean rotation qualifies), paid each year for up to 5 years.
money.condition.us-328-small-grain: Only if your application is selected: EQIP is competitive. NRCS Iowa's FY2026 rate for adding a small grain such as oats or wheat to a rotation of at least two other crops, paid each year for up to 5 years.
money.condition.us-328-perennial: Only if your application is selected: EQIP is competitive. NRCS Iowa's FY2026 rate for adding a short-term perennial such as alfalfa, kept at least two years, to a rotation of at least two other crops. Paid each year for up to 5 years.
money.condition.pl-cover-crop: Eco-scheme points for a winter cover crop mix of at least two species, sown 1 July to 1 October and kept until 15 February, or a small-seeded legume undersown in the main crop. Mustard or phacelia sown alone do not count. Spread over the years of this rotation that have a cover crop. Estimated 2026 rate, used for the advance payments; the final rate comes in a later regulation. ARiMR pays the eco-scheme only to farms that reach its minimum points.
money.condition.pl-crop-diversity: Eco-scheme points for a diverse crop structure. ARiMR checks the whole farm: at least three crops, the largest at most 65% of arable land, listed legumes at least 20%, cereals at most 65%, beet and potato at most 30%. This rotation meets the same shares over its years. Estimated 2026 rate, used for the advance payments; the final rate comes in a later regulation. In 2025 a coefficient cut this rate, so the final 2026 rate may be lower. ARiMR pays the eco-scheme only to farms that reach its minimum points.
money.condition.pl-straw: Eco-scheme point for chopping all the straw after harvest and mixing it into the soil or ploughing it in. Counted in the years with a cereal, maize, oilseed or legume grain crop. Estimated 2026 rate, used for the advance payments; the final rate comes in a later regulation. ARiMR pays the eco-scheme only to farms that reach its minimum points.
money.condition.pl-gaec7: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land. From 2026, farms of up to 30 ha of agricultural land are exempt from GAEC 7 checks and penalties (ARiMR).
money.condition.pl-gaec7-pass: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule, for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land: no crop stays on this field more than 3 years in a row. This rotation passes. The farm-wide rule that 40% of arable land changes crop every year is not checked here. From 2026, farms of up to 30 ha of agricultural land are exempt from GAEC 7 checks and penalties (ARiMR).
money.condition.pl-gaec7-fail: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule, for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land: {crop} stays on this field {years} years in a row, and 3 is the limit unless a cover crop follows it. Breaking the rule can cut the farm's area payments. From 2026, farms of up to 30 ha of agricultural land are exempt from GAEC 7 checks and penalties (ARiMR).
money.condition.pl-gaec7-fail-every: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule, for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land: {crop} is grown every year with no cover crop after it, and 3 years in a row is the limit. Breaking the rule can cut the farm's area payments. From 2026, farms of up to 30 ha of agricultural land are exempt from GAEC 7 checks and penalties (ARiMR).
